title: BATWA v2.4.49 Custom User Identity & Profile Persistence
message: Instant custom Batwa Tag (@tag) registration, dynamic profile name synchronization across Dashboard and Settings, and persistent user credentials.
features: Custom Batwa ID / Username: Exact user-selected tag is preserved on registration without random numbers.
Accurate Profile & Settings Sync: Dashboard and Settings display the real registered full name and tag handle.
Seamless Post-Registration Flow: Retains authenticated user identity directly from PIN setup.
Instant P2P Handle Copy: Quick copy action for personal Batwa tag in Settings.
changelog: Fixed username tag registration: customTag now accurately captured by backend.
Fixed Dashboard & Settings user display: replaces generic Batwa User with actual registered account name.
Added Batwa ID / Username tag badge and copy tile in Settings drawer.
Synchronized PinSetSuccess state into Authenticated identity session.
